title: Oven Roasted Malaysian Chicken Satay
description: A Malaysian dish featuring chicken satay cooked in the oven with a blend of spices and served with chilled butter, perfect for a date night. This recipe uses render-fat and is kosher-friendly, with the chicken wrapped in corn husks.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together coconut milk, render-fat, coriander, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken strips to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Wrap each chicken strip in a corn husk, securing with a toothpick if needed.
Place the wrapped chicken on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast the chicken in the preheated oven for 20 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the oven and serve with chilled butter.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro, if desired.
